title: Sharjah Publishers Conference 2025
summary: Rights meetings at table 162 with our 2025 catalogues.
body:
At the Publishers Conference, ahead of the Sharjah International Book Fair, we met publishers and rights professionals from around the world at table 162 with our 2025 catalogues, strengthening relationships and exploring new opportunities for our titles.

[Our look back at the Publishers Conference](/news/looking-ahead-to-the-sharjah-international-publishers-conference/)
